name: 95453 · Lakeport, CA
findings: ZIP 95453 (Lakeport) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95453 (Lakeport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95453 (Lakeport) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
